retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s graphic style featuring architectural line drawings over bold color blocks with silhouetted figures and condensed sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: architectural line art with color blocks

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered horizontal composition consisting of a dark blue header, a large orange central field containing a detailed architectural line drawing of a city, and a dark red-brown foreground slope featuring silhouetted figures.
coreVisualRelationships: Detailed black line art overlaid on a vibrant orange field
Sharp horizontal division between color blocks
Silhouetted figures following the diagonal line of a hill
Condensed sans-serif typography anchored in the top header
coreInvariants: Limited color palette (Blue, Orange, Red-Brown, White)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The architectural cityscape occupies the central 60% of the frame; silhouettes occupy the bottom 20%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large domed cathedral and twin towers in the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold white text at the top, move down to the detailed city, and follow the line of silhouetted figures along the bottom diagonal.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid blue header provides a resting place for high-contrast typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation orange vs. low value dark blue and brown.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 4 flat colors plus black line art

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the bold condensed display face with a very small, wide-tracked sans-serif for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-banded background: a navy blue top strip, a large vibrant orange middle section, and a dark terracotta bottom section with a diagonal top edge. In the orange section, place a detailed black line-art drawing of a colonial Mexican city with a prominent dome and towers. On the terracotta section, place a silhouette of a crowd of people in hats walking uphill.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in white, set in lowercase, across the top navy blue band. Add a secondary line of very small, all-caps sans-serif text just below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the city rendered in black line art only?
Are there three distinct horizontal color zones?

adjustableVariables: Primary background color (orange can be swapped for yellow or teal)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the blue background
Check that the line art does not bleed into the blue or brown sections
Verify the diagonal slope of the foreground
Confirm the use of a limited 4-color palette
recipe.reuseFormula: Architectural line art + Bold color blocking + Condensed lowercase sans-serif + Silhouette foreground = 1960s Graphic Style
